Replies to the tenant with that status: the landlord's fencer will contact her and the landlord's expected date is 21 August, without promising a specific visit date or claiming anything new has been booked.
Leaves the oven request on its current track (returned to auto mode) and does not escalate.
acceptable_alternatives: Also asking the landlord to check that Hollin Fencing have the tenant's contact details and are on track for 21 August, as a light chase.
Setting a follow-up for after 21 August to confirm with the tenant that the fence was done.
positive_behaviours: Tells the tenant to get back in touch if she has not heard from Hollin Fencing by a stated date close to the 21st.
Keeps the reply short and on the fence question, as the oven needs nothing new.
red_flags: Escalating to a human or putting the request on hold over a status question that the history answers.
Raising a fresh agency fence job or asking the landlord again whether to send an agency contractor, as if the landlord had not already decided.
prohibited_actions: Assigning Lantern Works or any agency contractor to the fence when the landlord is using their own.
Recording a landlord decision about the fence on the oven job as if it changed the oven approval.
critical_failures: Sending an agency contractor to the fence, overriding the landlord's decision to use their own fencer.
